obsidian.templateHint: Enclose YAML properties in ---. Placeholders: {{noteId}}, {{obsidianUri}}, {{repositoryUid}}, {{skillshubUri}}, {{fullName}}, {{url}}, {{description}}, {{stars}}, {{tags}}, {{categories}}. Use each placeholder as a whole YAML value without quotes; text, numbers and lists are escaped and retain their types. Custom properties are supported. skillshub_schema, skillshub_repository_id and skillshub_uri are maintained by SkillsHub. Linking or explicitly updating properties applies template keys; other existing properties and the body are preserved. Removing a template key does not delete that property from existing files. Note ID, repository ID, navigation links and schema version are protected fields.
